Description:

I like using them with the following additional mods:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister [/url]and various artists
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22876]Anime Seasonal Outfits[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/fifadog?gameId=1303]fifadog[/url] ; [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]Ohodavi's Portraits[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ohodavi?gameId=1303]ohodavi[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18972]Immersive Family - A Children's Events Expansion[/url] ﻿by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/59699651]xiaoleiwen[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17054]Immersive Unique Children Talk[/url] also by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/59699651]xiaoleiwen[/url]

[size=3][b][color=#f9cb9c]Note:[/color][color=#f6b26b] [/color][/b][u]These are just assets to be placed within respective folders it is required to be placed in. The portraits and sprites will work unless [b][color=#fff2cc]Content Patcher[/color][/b] or the [b][color=#fff2cc]Unique Children Mods[/color][/b] isn't updated to the current versions or you have installed incorrectly.[/u][/size]


[/font][quote][font=Verdana][b]WHAT PORTRAIT FILE TO DOWNLOAD AND INSTALL:[/b]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17054]Immersive Unique Children Talk[/url] installed: I recommend [b][u]Immersive Portraits[/u][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]If you have [i][b]just[/b][/i] the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9540]Unique Children Talk[/url] installed: I recommend the [u][b]Base Portraits[/b][/u][/size][/font]
[/list][/quote][font=Verdana]
[b]The difference?[/b] There are more expressions for more dialogues modded to be shown by ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/59699651]xiaoleiwen[/url] with their Immersive Mods!

[size=3][b]HOW TO INSTALL MY ASSETS IN REQUIRED MODS:[/b][/size]

[b]FOR [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6278]UNIQUE CHILDREN[/url][b] SPRITES FOLDER NAMED [ELLIOTT]:[/b]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Verdana]Unique Children > assets > [u]Natural/Adopted[/u][/font]
[/list][list=1]
[*]FIND THE [u]"Unique Children"[/u] FOLDER IN YOUR MODS.[img]https://i.ibb.co/Sm9KnqP/step-1.jpg[/img]﻿﻿﻿
[*]GO TO [u]"assets"[/u] AND PICK WHICH FOLDER[b] (Natural/Adopted) [/b]YOU WANT THE SPRITES IN.[img]https://i.ibb.co/YPsXFZP/step-2.jpg[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/g4mSqZq/step-3.jpg[/img]﻿﻿
[*]PASTE AND EXTRACT THE [u]"Elliott.zip"[/u] FILE INSIDE THE FOLDER.[img]https://i.ibb.co/GRkxpPm/step-4.jpg[/img]﻿
[/list][font=Verdana]
[b]FOR ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9540]UNIQUE CHILDREN TALK[/url]﻿ PORTRAITS NAMED [PORTRAITS]:[/b]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Verdana]UniqueChildren Talk > assets > [u]Portraits[/u][/font]
[/list]
[list=1]
[*]FIND THE [u]"Unique Children Talk"[/u] FOLDER IN YOUR MODS.[img]https://i.ibb.co/Sm9KnqP/step-1.jpg[/img]﻿
[*]GO TO [u]"assets"[/u] AND PASTE AND EXTRACT THE CHOSEN [u]"Portraits.zip"[/u] FILE INSIDE THE FOLDER.[img]https://i.ibb.co/YPsXFZP/step-2.jpg[/img][img]https://i.ibb.co/mTmRND6/step-3-uct.jpg[/img]﻿﻿

[/list][font=Verdana][i]
[/i]For the [u][b][color=#f9cb9c]Portraits[/color][/b][/u], you [b][u]need[/u][/b] to change the names [Eli] & [Lottie] to your children's names. You have to do it for every single image file to work.

[b]ex. [/b][b]Eli_Spring > Name_Spring[/b]

Please do note that you've renamed them in whatever sentence case you used in naming your children in-game. (example, elijah would be elijah_Spring/CHARLOTTE would be CHARLOTTE_Spring)



I actually use a different asset (Farmer-based) for Eli but I've made an Elliott-based one before so I just fixed it up a bit.[s] I will create a 6 expression portrait since I use the Immersive Mods but for now, here's a 4 portrait one![/s] It has been done now by referring the added expressions seen within the portraits of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18619]Haley's Children for Immersive Unique Children Talk[/url]﻿ as recommended of the modder, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/59699651]xiaoleiwen[/url] (Thank you!). [s]Now my next goal is to make the sprites and portraits for events![/s] 

[color=#f9cb9c]Hello again!
